pictures.observed: Inspected elevated tower view: red/patchy brick base,white cornice/clock bands,dark metal upper octagonal belfry with closed pointed shutter fields,green flared copper roof/tapered spire with narrow openings and gold ball/cross. Main nave roof meets tower below its clock. No temporary renovation equipment included.

Inspected complete southern profile: single west brick tower,large dark upper belfry/green flared spire,round gold-rimmed clocks and pale decorative patches/blind arches. Long copper gabled main nave with small round-headed clerestory windows/pale grouped blind niches,lower broad copper aisle roof,polygonal east choir with pyramidal copper roof/small finial and tall lower windows. Brick/stone lower walls. Exact brick weathering,sculpture,plaza and interior excluded.
